title: The complex field is algebraically closed
statement: The usual field $\mathbf C=\mathbf R\oplus i\mathbf R$, $i^2=-1$, is algebraically closed [def-weil-algebraic-closure]: every nonconstant polynomial $f\in\mathbf C[X]$ has a root in $\mathbf C$.

source.place: ## Proof, first paragraph: "the algebraic closure of $\sigma(L)$ inside $\mathbf C$"; the algebraic closedness of the complex ambient field required there. Mathlib/Analysis/Complex/Polynomial/Basic.lean:52, fundamental theorem of algebra.
